title: Mycelium Primal
what_this_is: Mycelium Primal (Primal for short): the open-source design system by Mycelium, design from first principles. Two things at once: a design system you install and use as it is, and the base every future Mycelium design system starts from, so its own look is minimal and set through tokens. Its architecture is the book's scale (primitive, cell, surface), classified by the promise each element keeps. Framework-independent core, one adapter set per framework, Angular first. Statements name no screen, store or file. This baseline is the seed (0.0.0): nothing is built, every chapter is declared empty here and filled by the ledger.
note: Drafted by Claude (session 7F-primal-foundation) on 2026-10-20 from Niko's v1 brief and his decisions in that session, and from his book through ~/.claude/guides/design-system-guides/01-design-system.md. Every requirement is 'proposed' until Niko approves the plan by merge; each is unverified until verified with evidence.
